CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation to content is stated.

COD.rationale: Coordinates (content+attribute) are listed together with explicit origin/status metadata for each p0/current/nX, yielding explicit C, O and D bindings.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to content presentation or access.

C.rationale: The report enumerates identified contents (red, blue) with explicit coordinate attributes.

D.rationale: Each content group includes separate origin/status metadata distinct from the coordinate content entries.

O.rationale: The report specifies how contents are presented (coordinates within a grid and grid orientation).
